name: io.github.tonyyang0504/careerjet-mcp
description: Careerjet (jobs): me, search. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_CAREERJET_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Careerjet publisher API key (free publisher sign-up at https://www.careerjet.com/partners/api/); sent as the HTTP Basic user name with an empty password.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_CAREERJET_USER_IP
environmentVariables.description: The end user's IP address, required by Careerjet as the user_ip query parameter on every call (403 'Missing param user_ip or user_agent' otherwise).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_CAREERJET_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: The end user's browser user agent, required by Careerjet as the user_agent query parameter on every call.
